title: The new caregiver asks for account access
scenario: A caregiver helping an older relative says the pharmacy portal keeps rejecting the refill. They ask for the relative’s email password so they can “sort it out while they are here.”

answers.A: Keep the password private and use delegated access, a pharmacy call, or sit with the relative while they log in themselves.
answers.B: Reset the pharmacy account and create a separate access method if the service supports it.
answers.C: Share the password temporarily, then change it after the refill is complete.

explanation: A legitimate helper may have a legitimate need, but shared master credentials create unnecessary risk and confusion later.
proTip: Help should get the least access needed to help.
